listed.subject: Victor Wembanyama
listed.text_zh: Victor Wembanyama 被貼身（2 呎內）防守還能投 70%（同類型球員平均 46%）
listed.text_en: Victor Wembanyama shoots 70% even with a defender within 2 ft (players in a similar role: 46%)
listed.basis_zh: 根據 44 次被貼身防守的出手（2026-27 例行賽）；同類型：Giannis Antetokounmpo、Anthony Davis 等 30 人
listed.basis_en: Based on 44 tightly contested shots (2026-27 regular season); similar role: Giannis Antetokounmpo, Anthony Davis and 28 more

listed.subject: Nickeil Alexander-Walker
listed.text_zh: Nickeil Alexander-Walker 在關鍵時刻投了全隊 40% 的球（21/52），其他時間只投 17%
listed.text_en: Nickeil Alexander-Walker takes 40% of his team's clutch shots (21/52), vs 17% of the rest
listed.basis_zh: 根據 52 次全隊關鍵時刻出手（2026-27 例行賽）；關鍵時刻＝第四節或延長賽最後 5 分鐘、分差 5 分內
listed.basis_en: Based on 52 team clutch shots (2026-27 regular season); clutch = last 5 minutes of the 4th quarter or overtime, within 5 points
